newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - ABN AMRO initiates Acindar.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ABN AMRO initiates Acindar.

text.p: - ABN AMRO Hoare Govett said it initiated Argentine steelmaker Acindar with a "hold."
- "Acindar's restructuring and modernization plans are showing signs of success. The recovery of the Argentine economy presents the opportunity to capitalize on them," said ABN AMRO.
- It expected improvement in earnings quality thanks to "higher sales, better operating margins and lower interest expense."
- Operating profit is forecast to rise to 46.1 million pesos this year, 51.2 million pesos in 1998 and 55.7 million pesos in 1999 compared with 21.5 million pesos last year.
